title: Property-Based Testing for Safety: Generating Adversarial Prompts from Specifications

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Formal specification of safety properties with automated generation of test inputs is a direct, actionable contribution. If a spec-driven approach discovers systematic gaps, it reduces red-teaming cost and improves coverage. Clear causal chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Hypothesis library is beginner-friendly. Using a weaker LLM as generator and StrongReject as checker is a simple loop. Defining a small set of safety properties and running the generator is feasible in 30 hours with medium compute.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Can be tightly scoped to one safety property (e.g., refuse synthesis requests), one generator model, one checker. Clear deliverable: set of auto-generated inputs that violate the property, plus pass/fail statistics.
